dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent irregular light-colored 'O' and 'C' shaped ring structures exhibit sharp pixel intensity gradients transitioning from the dark background skin to high-intensity perimeters, enclosing darker interior core regions. These are most concentrated in the mid-dorsal and lateral zones.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: There is a high spatial density of localized, solid high-intensity light pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily located in the posterior lateral region and clustered near the base of the visible flipper.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent dorsal macro-annuli form a scalene triangle in the upper mid-section. A secondary constellation of four high-intensity blobs forms an irregular quadrilateral pattern in the posterior third of the visible body.

other_distinctive_markers: The distal edge of the pectoral flipper displays five distinct, dark, elongated rectangular pixel groupings. Multiple deep, dark, transverse curvilinear features are visible in the neck region, consistent with skin folds.
